Crank Votes to Advance Reconciliation 3.0 Process July 22, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. -- Today, Representative Jeff Crank (CO-05) voted in favor of the FY27 Budget Resolution, taking the first step toward advancing the SAVE and Protect America Act through the budget reconciliation process.   The budget resolution provides the framework needed for Congress to advance legislation that strengthens our national defense, secures our elections, and supports America’s farmers and ranchers.   "By starting the Budget Reconciliation process, Congressional Republicans are gearing up for the SAVE and Protect America Act," said Rep. Crank. "This bill will secure our elections through voter ID requirements, secure our troops by giving them the resources they need to stay ahead of our adversaries, and support the farmers who keep food on Americans’ tables.”   Background: The resolution contains $95 billion: $10 billion to secure our federal elections with critical integrity measures included in the SAVE America Act . $60 billion to provide funding for operational costs, military pay and readiness, and munitions investment, to support our service members and ensure the U.S. military remains the most lethal fighting force across the globe. $13 billion to fund intelligence-related activities to protect our nation. $12 billion to provide economic assistance for American farmers and food producers to ensure our nation’s food supply remains secure and affordable. ### Media Press Releases In the News

In an interview with Fox News Digital , Representative Crank highlighted the need to put Democrats on the record and take a public stance against the DSA and socialism. The resolution condemns socialism in all its forms and highlights the un-American tenets the DSA aspires to, including allowing noncitizens and incarcerated criminals to vote in American elections. It also reaffirms support for free, fair, and secure elections and the principle that American elections should be decided by American citizens.  The DSA have permeated elections across the country and have co-opted much of the Democratic party. While freedom-loving citizens across the country know that socialism is the first step to communism, and that every communist regime has brought only oppression, murder and starvation, the highest levels of Democrat leadership refuse to denounce DSA for fear of political retribution among their ranks. Rep. Crank’s resolution is scheduled to be voted on the House Floor early this week. Read the resolution here. ### Media Press Releases In the News
